vocabulary.meaning: 令人筋疲力尽的；艰难的

subtitles.en: Good to be with you.
subtitles.zh: 很高兴和大家见面。

subtitles.en: I'm Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 我是托尼·多库皮尔。

subtitles.en: The breaking news right now.
subtitles.zh: 现在来看突发新闻。

subtitles.en: Hurricane emergency-- Isaias rapidly intensifying tonight, now a Category 2 storm, sustained winds up to 100 miles an hour.
subtitles.zh: 飓风紧急状态——伊萨亚斯今晚快速增强，现已成为2级风暴，持续风速最高每小时100英里。

subtitles.en: Alabama, Georgia, and Florida in the danger zone.
subtitles.zh: 阿拉巴马州、佐治亚州和佛罗里达州都处于危险区域。

subtitles.en: And more than 100 million Americans will feel the impacts.
subtitles.zh: 超过一亿美国人将受到影响。

subtitles.en: Also tonight, a hero's homecoming for the USS Lincoln, sailors and Marines reunited with their loved ones, including more than 50 babies born during that grueling combat deployment in the Middle East.
subtitles.zh: 今晚还有，林肯号上的英雄归来，水兵和海军陆战队员与亲人团聚，其中包括50多名在那次艰苦的中东战斗部署期间出生的宝宝。

subtitles.en: The Pentagon says the firing squad execution of the Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed.
subtitles.zh: 五角大楼表示，对胡德堡枪手的行刑队处决将进行直播。

subtitles.en: Donald Trump Jr.'s ex-fiancée, Kimberly Guilfoyle, caught in text messages allegedly begging a major Republican donor to pay her $100,000 credit card bill.
subtitles.zh: 小唐纳德·特朗普的前未婚妻金伯利·吉尔福伊尔被曝在短信中据称哀求一位共和党大金主帮她还10万美元信用卡账单。

subtitles.en: And a Missouri teenager killed on the side of the road.
subtitles.zh: 密苏里州一名少女在路边遇难。

subtitles.en: Her parents told it was a hit and run-- what really happened.
subtitles.zh: 她的父母被告知是肇事逃逸——但真相究竟如何。

subtitles.en: One of the deadliest attacks in Ukraine this year.
subtitles.zh: 乌克兰今年最致命的袭击之一。

subtitles.en: Two city buses blown up by a powerful Russian-guided bomb, killing at least 30 people.
subtitles.zh: 两辆城市公交车被一枚强大的俄制制导炸弹炸毁，造成至少30人死亡。

subtitles.en: A lost dog wanders into a police station-- what happened next.
subtitles.zh: 一只走失的狗溜进警察局——接下来发生的事让人意外。

subtitles.en: And the good stuff-- a chemistry teacher's challenge and the $100 reward.
subtitles.zh: 还有好消息——一位化学老师的挑战和100美元奖励。

subtitles.en: ANNOUNCER: From CBS News headquarters in New York, this is the CBS Evening News with Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 这里是纽约CBS新闻总部，这里是CBS晚间新闻，由托尼·多库皮尔主持。

subtitles.en: Good evening, and great to have you with us on a Thursday night.
subtitles.zh: 晚上好，很高兴在周四晚上与您相伴。

subtitles.en: We begin with what is now a Category 2 hurricane barreling toward the Gulf Coast.
subtitles.zh: 我们先来关注目前已达2级、正向墨西哥湾沿岸猛冲的飓风。

subtitles.en: The winds have been picking up throughout the day, and mandatory evacuations are in effect.
subtitles.zh: 风力一整天都在增强，强制撤离令已经生效。

subtitles.en: Alabama, Florida, and Georgia all under states of emergency as Hurricane Isaias is expected to strengthen before making landfall tomorrow night.
subtitles.zh: 阿拉巴马、佛罗里达和佐治亚三州都已进入紧急状态，预计飓风伊萨亚斯在明晚登陆前还会加强。

subtitles.en: Rob Marciano has the latest forecast in just a moment, but we're going to begin with Jason Allen in Orange Beach, Alabama, the middle of the storm's path.
subtitles.zh: 罗布·马西亚诺稍后带来最新预报，但我们先连线位于阿拉巴马州奥兰治海滩、正处风暴路径中央的杰森·艾伦。

subtitles.en: Jason, good evening to you.
subtitles.zh: 杰森，晚上好。

subtitles.en: How is it looking now?
subtitles.zh: 现在情况怎么样？

subtitles.en: Tony, good evening.
subtitles.zh: 托尼，晚上好。

subtitles.en: We got overcast skies here in Alabama and across the Gulf ahead of this storm.
subtitles.zh: 在阿拉巴马这里以及整个墨西哥湾，风暴来临前天空阴沉。

subtitles.en: I've been watching that bridge back behind me, carrying all that traffic away from the beach and further inland ahead of the storm the residents here hoped might not ever happen this season, but now looks to be inevitable.
subtitles.zh: 我一直在看我身后那座桥，车流正从海滩向内陆撤离，以躲避这场当地居民原本希望本季不会出现、但现在看来已不可避免的风暴。

subtitles.en: Hurricane Isaias is crawling toward the Gulf Coast, with steady strong winds kicking up surf along Pensacola Beach, Florida.
subtitles.zh: 飓风伊萨亚斯正缓慢逼近墨西哥湾沿岸，持续强风在佛罗里达州彭萨科拉海滩掀起大浪。

subtitles.en: Double red flags indicated beaches were closed, with dangerous rip currents already developing.
subtitles.zh: 两面红旗表示海滩已经关闭，危险的离岸流已经开始形成。

subtitles.en: High tides have already put low-lying roads underwater.
subtitles.zh: 涨潮已经使低洼道路被水淹没。

subtitles.en: Bumper-to-bumper traffic stretched for miles along several coastal counties as people moved inland.
subtitles.zh: 随着人们向内陆转移，几个沿海县的道路上车流绵延数英里。

subtitles.en: This is expected to make impacts with the winds as early as Friday afternoon.
subtitles.zh: 预计最早周五下午就会开始受到大风影响。

subtitles.en: JASON ALLEN: From Florida to Mississippi, coastal residents and business operators are shutting down and boarding up.
subtitles.zh: 从佛罗里达到密西西比，沿海居民和商户都在停业并加固门窗。

subtitles.en: Hardware and grocery store shelves are bare as people stock up on emergency supplies.
subtitles.zh: 五金店和杂货店的货架被抢购一空，人们纷纷囤积应急物资。

subtitles.en: The run on fuel has also left some gas stations on empty.
subtitles.zh: 燃油抢购也导致一些加油站无油可加。

subtitles.en: I've gotten gas.
subtitles.zh: 我已经加满油了。

subtitles.en: I've gotten cash, just taking all the precautions.
subtitles.zh: 我取了现金，做了所有预防措施。

subtitles.en: Generators have been a huge push already.
subtitles.zh: 发电机已经非常抢手。

subtitles.en: And water is definitely on the move, for sure.
subtitles.zh: 水肯定也很紧俏。

subtitles.en: Away from the immediate coastline, there's a real concern for the potential for flooding in places like this and just how far a 5 to 7-foot storm surge from Isaias could push into these rivers and inlets and wetlands.
subtitles.zh: 在离海岸线稍远的地方，人们非常担心这样的地方可能发生洪水，以及伊萨亚斯带来的5到7英尺风暴潮会沿这些河流、入海口和湿地推进多远。

subtitles.en: In Gulf Shores, Alabama, Danny Patton still has the high-water mark on his door-- So right here.
subtitles.zh: 在阿拉巴马州格尔夫肖尔斯，丹尼·帕顿家的门上还留着高水位线——就在这里。

subtitles.en: Right here was Ivan in '04.
subtitles.zh: 这里就是2004年伊万留下的。

subtitles.en: JASON ALLEN: --from Hurricane Ivan 22 years ago.
subtitles.zh: ——那是22年前的飓风伊万留下的。

subtitles.en: He wants to stay but, because he has his grandkids, is headed hundreds of miles north to be with family.
subtitles.zh: 他想留下来，但因为有孙辈在身边，正前往数百英里以北的家人那里。

subtitles.en: My gut feeling is, I want to hang out and stay, but I feel like my wife would have overruled that.
subtitles.zh: 我的直觉是想留下来，但我觉得我妻子会否决这个想法。

subtitles.en: There's no doubt.
subtitles.zh: 毫无疑问。

subtitles.en: I'm going north with my family.
subtitles.zh: 我要和家人一起北上。

subtitles.en: And this is one of those creeks that is connected to Mobile Bay, where the storm surge is a concern.
subtitles.zh: 这是与莫比尔湾相连的其中一条小溪，那里是风暴潮的隐患区域。

subtitles.en: And you saw all the boats tied up back here.
subtitles.zh: 你也看到了，后面这些船都系好了。

subtitles.en: We just talked to a couple who is planning to ride this hurricane out on their boat.
subtitles.zh: 我们刚和一对夫妇聊过，他们打算在船上挺过这场飓风。

subtitles.en: Tony?
subtitles.zh: 托尼？

subtitles.en: We wish them the best.
subtitles.zh: 我们祝他们好运。

subtitles.en: Jason, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 杰森，谢谢。

subtitles.en: All right.
subtitles.zh: 好的。

subtitles.en: Let's get the forecast from meteorologist Rob Marciano.
subtitles.zh: 下面请气象学家罗布·马西亚诺带来天气预报。

subtitles.en: He's tracking the hurricane tonight in Pensacola, Florida.
subtitles.zh: 他今晚在佛罗里达州彭萨科拉追踪飓风。

subtitles.en: Rob, good evening.
subtitles.zh: 罗布，晚上好。

subtitles.en: What do you know?
subtitles.zh: 你了解到什么情况？

subtitles.en: Well, Tony, this storm is developing as per the forecast.
subtitles.zh: 托尼，这场风暴正如预报的那样发展。

subtitles.en: It sits about 414 miles from where I stand.
subtitles.zh: 它距我所站的位置约414英里。

subtitles.en: And we're getting higher confidence now as to what this place will look like come tomorrow night.
subtitles.zh: 我们现在更有把握判断明晚这里会是什么样子。

subtitles.en: The center line brings it right to Pensacola Beach.
subtitles.zh: 这条中心路径会把它直接带到彭萨科拉海滩。

subtitles.en: There, you see on the satellite picture now, it has an eye with that Category 2 status.
subtitles.zh: 从卫星图像上可以看到，它现在已经形成风眼，达到二级飓风状态。

subtitles.en: It will strengthen even more as we go through the next 12 hours, going over some very warm water, but then enduring some wind shear, hopefully knocks it down a little bit.
subtitles.zh: 接下来12小时里，它经过非常温暖的海水，还会进一步增强；但之后会遇到风切变，希望能把它削弱一点。

subtitles.en: Either way, it's going to be a large and destructive storm by tomorrow night.
subtitles.zh: 不管怎样，到明晚它会成为一场大规模、破坏力强的风暴。

subtitles.en: Hurricane watches have been upgraded to warnings early this morning.
subtitles.zh: 飓风观察预警已于今天清晨升级为警报。

subtitles.en: And they extend from parts of Mississippi through Alabama, all the way through Panama City.
subtitles.zh: 这些警报范围从密西西比州部分地区延伸，穿过阿拉巴马州，一直到巴拿马城。

subtitles.en: And that's where you'll see your destructive winds.
subtitles.zh: 那里将出现破坏性大风。

subtitles.en: They actually will extend out from the center of the storm by about 150 miles.
subtitles.zh: 这些大风实际上会从风暴中心向外延伸约150英里。

subtitles.en: That includes these tropical storm warnings.
subtitles.zh: 其中也包括这些热带风暴警报。

subtitles.en: The storm surge always an issue in this area, especially 4 to 7 feet.
subtitles.zh: 风暴潮在这个地区始终是个问题，尤其是4到7英尺的增水。

subtitles.en: And then the inland rainfall, not just along I-10, but up through I-20, I-40, and all the way into the northeast will see rain through this weekend.
subtitles.zh: 然后是内陆降雨，不只沿 I-10，还会沿 I-20、I-40 一直延伸至东北部，这个周末都会出现降雨。

subtitles.en: So a large chunk of this eastern half of the country will be feeling parts of this hurricane.
subtitles.zh: 所以美国东半部的大部分地区都会感受到这场飓风的影响。

subtitles.en: Tony?
subtitles.zh: 托尼？

subtitles.en: All right, Rob.
subtitles.zh: 好的，罗布。

subtitles.en: Thank you.
subtitles.zh: 谢谢。

subtitles.en: And we turn now to San Diego and that hero's homecoming for the crew aboard the USS Lincoln, all of them just awarded a citation for valor in combat.
subtitles.zh: 我们现在转向圣地亚哥，林肯号航母上的舰员们迎来英雄归来，他们刚因在战斗中的英勇表现获得嘉奖。

subtitles.en: More than 5,000 sailors and Marines back on land tonight and reunited with someone they love, including dozens of dads meeting their newborns for the first time.
subtitles.zh: 超过5000名水兵和海军陆战队员今晚回到陆上，与所爱之人团聚，其中有几十位父亲第一次见到自己的新生儿。

subtitles.en: Our Carter Evans was there to see it.
subtitles.zh: 我们的记者卡特·埃文斯在现场见证。

subtitles.en: CARTER EVANS: It's an emotional reunion after 321 days away from home.
subtitles.zh: 这是离家321天后的一次激动团聚。

subtitles.en: Today, Lieutenant Commander Brendan Lee is meeting his daughter, Margaret, for the first time.
subtitles.zh: 今天，海军少校布伦丹·李第一次见到女儿玛格丽特。

subtitles.en: But it's all worth it now.
subtitles.zh: 但现在一切都值得了。

subtitles.en: CARTER EVANS: He had planned to be home in time for her birth, but while at sea, his deployment was extended.
subtitles.zh: 他原本计划在她出生前赶回家，但出海期间，他的部署被延长了。

subtitles.en: I'm prideful of what we've done.
subtitles.zh: 我为我们所做的一切感到自豪。

subtitles.en: I'm prideful that we got this ship back safely.
subtitles.zh: 我为这艘船安全返航感到自豪。

subtitles.en: And now I can be a dad.
subtitles.zh: 现在我可以当爸爸了。

subtitles.en: CARTER EVANS: When the US and Israel struck Iran in February, the USS Lincoln joined the campaign, with more than 3,600 combat missions, launching 450 missiles and sinking 64 Iranian warships.
subtitles.zh: 今年2月美国和以色列打击伊朗时，林肯号加入了行动，执行了超过3600次作战任务，发射了450枚导弹，击沉了64艘伊朗军舰。

subtitles.en: The aircraft carrier spent a record 265-day continuous stretch at sea.
subtitles.zh: 这艘航母在海上连续执行任务达创纪录的265天。

subtitles.en: Families of the roughly 5,000 sailors and Marines aboard reported food and hygiene product shortages and declining mental health.
subtitles.zh: 舰上约5000名水兵和海军陆战队员的家属反映，存在食品和卫生用品短缺以及心理健康状况下降的问题。

subtitles.en: The Navy says eight sailors in the strike group attempted suicide.
subtitles.zh: 海军称，该打击群中有8名水兵曾试图自杀。

subtitles.en: With the ship showing rust and wear from war, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth spoke to the crew Wednesday.
subtitles.zh: 由于军舰因战争出现锈蚀和损耗，国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯周三向舰员发表了讲话。

subtitles.en: A few folks in the media who tried to turn the USS Abraham Lincoln into some sort of a symbol, a symbol of dysfunction-- I know it's the exact opposite.
subtitles.zh: 媒体里有些人试图把亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母说成某种象征，一个运转失灵的象征——我知道事实恰恰相反。

subtitles.en: But the focus now is on first hugs and kisses and finally making families whole again.
subtitles.zh: 但现在的重点是第一次拥抱和亲吻，终于让家庭重新完整。

subtitles.en: Overwhelming and amazing, everything I've waited for.
subtitles.zh: 太激动、太棒了，这就是我一直等待的。

subtitles.en: The next mission for these sailors is downtime.
subtitles.zh: 这些水兵的下一个任务是休整。

subtitles.en: And for many of them, that starts today.
subtitles.zh: 对其中许多人来说，从今天就开始了。

subtitles.en: They'll also each be getting a full health assessment while the USS Lincoln gets some much-needed maintenance.
subtitles.zh: 他们每个人还将接受全面健康评估，同时林肯号也会进行亟需的维护保养。

subtitles.en: Tony?
subtitles.zh: 托尼？

subtitles.en: Welcome home.
subtitles.zh: 欢迎回家。

subtitles.en: Carter, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 卡特，谢谢。

subtitles.en: We also have news tonight on the Pentagon's plans for the Fort Hood shooter convicted of that rampage in Texas in 2009.
subtitles.zh: 今晚我们还有关于五角大楼计划的消息，对象是2009年在得克萨斯州胡德堡制造枪击案并被定罪的凶手。

subtitles.en: He will die by firing squad December 3.
subtitles.zh: 他将于12月3日被行刑队枪决。

subtitles.en: And Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said today that death will be public.
subtitles.zh: 国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯今天表示，死刑将公开执行。

subtitles.en: More now from senior national security correspondent, Charlie D'Agata in Washington.
subtitles.zh: 下面请高级国家安全记者查理·达加塔从华盛顿带来更详细的报道。

subtitles.en: Charlie, good evening.
subtitles.zh: 查理，晚上好。

subtitles.en: Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 是的。

subtitles.en: Tony, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the Pentagon will make sure that people are able to watch the execution of Nidal Hasan.
subtitles.zh: 托尼，国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯说，五角大楼将确保人们能够看到尼达尔·哈桑的死刑执行过程。

subtitles.en: A US official confirmed tonight that it is expected to be livestreamed.
subtitles.zh: 一名美国官员今晚证实，预计将进行网络直播。

subtitles.en: It's scheduled for December 3 at 2:00 PM Eastern at Fort Hood.
subtitles.zh: 行刑时间定于东部时间12月3日下午2点，地点在胡德堡。

subtitles.en: That's the same time 17 years ago, Hasan opened fire, killing 13 people, wounding 32 more at Fort Hood, a massacre he later said was carried out in support of the Taliban.
subtitles.zh: 17年前的同一时间，哈桑在胡德堡开枪，打死13人，打伤32人。他后来称，那场屠杀是为了支持塔利班。

subtitles.en: So Secretary Hegseth justified the public airing of the execution, saying people need to understand there are serious consequences.
subtitles.zh: 赫格塞斯部长为公开播出死刑执行过程辩护，称人们需要明白，这类行为会带来严重后果。

subtitles.en: But obviously, this would be an extraordinary event.
subtitles.zh: 但显然，这将是一个非同寻常的事件。

subtitles.en: An execution viewable by the general public is virtually unheard of.
subtitles.zh: 普通公众可以观看死刑执行，这几乎闻所未闻。

subtitles.en: Now, if it happens, Pentagon said it would be the first execution by firing squad by the Army since World War II.
subtitles.zh: 如果成真，五角大楼称这将是陆军自二战以来第一次由行刑队执行死刑。

subtitles.en: Tony?
subtitles.zh: 托尼？

subtitles.en: Charlie, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 查理，谢谢。

subtitles.en: We've got breaking news now from New York City, a shooting involving an ICE officer in the Bronx.
subtitles.zh: 现在播报来自纽约市的突发新闻，布朗克斯区发生一起涉及移民与海关执法局官员的枪击事件。

subtitles.en: The early word from the scene is that immigration officers were trying to make an arrest when an agent fired on someone else nearby.
subtitles.zh: 来自现场的初步消息称，移民官员当时正试图实施逮捕，突然一名执法人员向附近的另一个人开枪。

subtitles.en: Emergency crews brought that person to the hospital with injuries the NYPD says are not life threatening.
subtitles.zh: 急救人员将伤者送往医院，纽约警方称其伤势没有生命危险。

subtitles.en: Now to a new headache for the White House-- Donald Trump Jr.'s ex-fiancée, Kimberly Guilfoyle, who is the current US ambassador to Greece, allegedly pushed a Republican donor to pay off her six-figure credit card bill and then hide the paper trail.
subtitles.zh: 现在来看白宫的新麻烦——小唐纳德·特朗普的前未婚妻、现任美国驻希腊大使金伯利·吉尔福伊尔据称向一名共和党捐款人施压，要求对方还清她六位数的信用卡账单，并掩盖相关书面记录。

subtitles.en: What might she have been offering in return?
subtitles.zh: 她可能拿什么作为回报呢？

subtitles.en: Here's Senior White House correspondent Weijia Jiang.
subtitles.zh: 下面由白宫资深记者 Weijia Jiang 报道。

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: Leaving Athens, a frustrated Secretary of State Marco Rubio dismissed questions about Ambassador Kimberly Guilfoyle's alleged behavior.
subtitles.zh: 离开雅典时，一脸沮丧的国务卿马可·鲁比奥对有关大使金伯利·吉尔福伊尔被控行为的提问不予理会。

subtitles.en: We don't conduct these things in a press conference on a tarmac in a foreign country because you wrote a story or somebody else wrote a story because some source gave it to you.
subtitles.zh: 我们不会因为你们写了篇报道、或者别人写了篇报道、某个消息源给你们透了料，就在国外机场停机坪的记者会上处理这些事情。

subtitles.en: So get that out of your head.
subtitles.zh: 所以，别再有这种念头了。

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: The story involves Trump donor and businessman Eric Deters, who claims Guilfoyle asked him for $100,000 to pay off her American Express bill just days before her Senate confirmation hearing.
subtitles.zh: 这件事涉及特朗普捐助人、商人埃里克·德特斯，他声称吉尔福伊尔在参议院确认听证会前几天找他要10万美元，用来还她的美国运通卡账单。

subtitles.en: She allegedly texted Deters, "I have been officially announced.
subtitles.zh: 据称她给德特斯发短信说：“我已经被正式宣布了。”

subtitles.en: Honey, please.
subtitles.zh: 亲爱的，拜托了。

subtitles.en: I need you to get this done for me today" and sent instructions on how to wire money to her Amex account.
subtitles.zh: 我今天就需要你帮我把这件事办好。”她还发去了如何把钱汇到她美国运通账户的说明。

subtitles.en: She was trying to grift me for $100,000.
subtitles.zh: 她当时想从我这儿骗走10万美元。

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: Deters claims she promised him access to top White House officials.
subtitles.zh: 德特斯声称，她承诺能让他接触到白宫高层官员。

subtitles.en: It was quid pro quo, knowing she was going to become Greek ambassador.
subtitles.zh: 这是利益交换，因为她知道自己要当希腊大使。

subtitles.en: She was willing to be my advocate inside Trump world for anything and everything I ever asked for and wanted.
subtitles.zh: 她愿意在特朗普圈子里替我说话，但凡我提过的、想要的任何事，她都会帮我推动。

subtitles.en: And I believe in Donald John Trump!
subtitles.zh: 而且我相信唐纳德·约翰·特朗普！

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: Guilfoyle, once a MAGA star and engaged to Donald Trump, Jr, is now under fire from Democrats, who are calling for Rubio to investigate her alleged conduct.
subtitles.zh: 吉尔福伊尔曾经是MAGA明星，还和小唐纳德·特朗普订过婚，如今却遭到民主党人抨击，他们要求卢比奥调查她被指控的行为。

subtitles.en: It's embarrassing to the people of the United States to continually appoint an ambassador who, seemingly, is trying to just enrich herself.
subtitles.zh: 不断任命一个似乎只想中饱私囊的人当大使，这让美国人民很难堪。

subtitles.en: Deters says he paid Guilfoyle $300,000 in the past for making appearances during events that he hosted but said he did not pay her in this instance.
subtitles.zh: 德特斯说，过去他曾付给吉尔福伊尔30万美元，让她在自己主办的活动上露面，但他说这一次他没有付钱。

subtitles.en: CBS News reached out directly to Guilfoyle and her legal team for comment, but they have not responded, Tony.
subtitles.zh: CBS新闻直接联系了吉尔福伊尔及其法律团队寻求评论，但他们尚未回应，托尼。

subtitles.en: All right.
subtitles.zh: 好的。

subtitles.en: Weijia, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 维佳，谢谢你。

subtitles.en: We turn now to rural Missouri and questions surrounding the death of a teenage girl and whether a sheriff's deputy tried to frame it as a hit and run.
subtitles.zh: 我们转向密苏里州乡村地区，一名少女死亡引发疑问：一名警长副手是否试图将其伪造成交通肇事逃逸。

subtitles.en: CBS's Ian Lee is there.
subtitles.zh: CBS记者伊恩·李在现场报道。
一、二、三。

subtitles.en: IAN LEE: Today, colorful balloons were released to honor the memory of 16-year-old Persephone Berger, who was killed Saturday Morning in St. Francis County, near St. Louis As her family and friends grieve, they're demanding to know why it took days to learn that she was struck and killed by a deputy sheriff's vehicle.
subtitles.zh: 今天，人们放飞彩色气球纪念16岁的珀耳塞福涅·伯杰。她于周六早上在圣路易斯附近的圣弗朗西斯县遇难。她的亲友在悲痛中要求知道，为什么要过好几天才得知她是一名副警长的车撞死的。

subtitles.en: They just blatantly lied to us and said she was involved in a hit and run.
subtitles.zh: 他们就是明目张胆地对我们撒谎，说她卷入了一起肇事逃逸。

subtitles.en: The sheriff's department says the deputy responded to a 911 call from a driver who saw someone lying in this roadway around 3:40 AM.
subtitles.zh: 警长办公室称，这名副警长是接到一名司机在凌晨3点40分左右打来的911电话，司机看到有人躺在这条车道上。

subtitles.en: According to officials, the arriving deputy saw the hazard lights of the caller's car but did not see the girl in the street.
subtitles.zh: 据官员说，赶到现场的副警长看到了报警人车辆的危险警示灯，但没有看到街上的女孩。

subtitles.en: She was struck and killed.
subtitles.zh: 她被撞身亡。

subtitles.en: The officer remained at the scene.
subtitles.zh: 这名警员留在了现场。

subtitles.en: My world shattered right then.
subtitles.zh: 那一刻我的世界崩塌了。

subtitles.en: I mean-- IAN LEE: In a preliminary autopsy, the coroner revealed that Berger had no previous physical injuries and her injuries were consistent with those sustained from the responding deputy's vehicle.
subtitles.zh: 我的意思是——伊恩·李：初步尸检显示，验尸官透露伯杰此前没有其他身体损伤，她的伤势与涉事副警长车辆造成的损伤一致。

subtitles.en: Nobody contacted my brother.
subtitles.zh: 没人联系过我兄弟。

subtitles.en: Only one that contacted him within that three-day limit was the coroner.
subtitles.zh: 在那三天时间里，唯一联系过他的只有验尸官。

subtitles.en: IAN LEE: Berger's aunt claims her niece snuck out of the house to go to a neighborhood party and was returning home when she was hit.
subtitles.zh: 伯杰的阿姨说，她的侄女偷偷溜出家门去参加附近一个聚会，是在回家的路上被撞的。

subtitles.en: We're not going to stop until they tell the truth.
subtitles.zh: 在他们说出真相之前，我们是不会罢休的。

subtitles.en: CBS News has reached out to the St. Francis County Sheriff's Department but has not heard back.
subtitles.zh: CBS新闻已联系圣弗朗西斯县警长办公室，但尚未收到回复。

subtitles.en: The Missouri State Highway Patrol is leading the investigation into the accident.
subtitles.zh: 密苏里州高速公路巡警正在牵头调查这起事故。

subtitles.en: Meanwhile, funeral services for Berger will take place Saturday.
subtitles.zh: 与此同时，伯杰的葬礼将于周六举行。

subtitles.en: Tony?
subtitles.zh: 托尼？

subtitles.en: Ian, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 伊恩，谢谢你。

subtitles.en: Overseas now to Ukraine in its war with Russia, today one of the deadliest single strikes this year.
subtitles.zh: 接下来看海外，乌克兰与俄罗斯的战事，今天遭遇了今年最致命的单次袭击之一。

subtitles.en: At least 30 dead in Eastern Ukraine after a Russian glide bomb hit two buses-- that carnage just a day after a missile hit an apartment block, killing 22 people, among them, five children.
subtitles.zh: 乌克兰东部，一枚俄罗斯滑翔炸弹击中两辆巴士，造成至少30人死亡。而就在一天前，一枚导弹击中一栋公寓楼，造成22人死亡，其中包括5名儿童。

subtitles.en: Ukraine's President Zelenskyy called that attack vile and is appealing now for additional air defenses as winter closes in.
subtitles.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基称那次袭击“卑鄙无耻”，并随着冬季临近，正在呼吁获得更多防空系统。

subtitles.en: And in France, some public schools have been closed since Monday amid nationwide student and now labor protests raging for three weeks.
subtitles.zh: 而在法国，全国性的学生抗议、如今还有劳工抗议已持续三周，一些公立学校自周一以来一直关闭。

subtitles.en: CBS's Aidan Stretch reports tonight from Paris.
subtitles.zh: CBS记者艾丹·斯特雷奇今晚从巴黎报道。

subtitles.en: AIDAN STRETCH: Riot police clashed with students in Paris Bastille Square after another day of protests.
subtitles.zh: 又一天的抗议之后，防暴警察在巴黎巴士底广场与学生发生冲突。

subtitles.en: You can see that the police have started to hose down the protesters-- the protesters were throwing rocks and tables at the restaurant-- as they try and move the protesters away from the Bastille and towards the nation square.
subtitles.zh: 可以看到警察已经开始用水枪喷射抗议者——抗议者当时朝餐厅扔石头和桌子——同时他们试图把抗议者从巴士底广场赶往国家广场方向。

subtitles.en: More than 24,000 people demonstrated just in Paris.
subtitles.zh: 仅在巴黎就有超过2.4万人参加示威。

subtitles.en: One of those, 17-year-old Kailyn, a high school student in Seine-Saint-Denis, a nearby suburb that's the poorest district in France.
subtitles.zh: 其中之一是17岁的凯琳，他是塞纳-圣但尼的一名高中生。那是附近的一个郊区，也是法国最贫困的地区。

subtitles.en: He told us about poor conditions and overcrowding in schools.
subtitles.zh: 他向我们讲述了学校条件差、过度拥挤的情况。

subtitles.en: And in other, we are over 40 or 38, which is a lot and too much for only one student.
subtitles.zh: 而在另一个班，我们有超过40或38个人，这对一个学生来说太多了，负担太重。

subtitles.en: AIDAN STRETCH: Teachers at a different school in the same area gave us these videos, showing bathrooms, classrooms, hallways, all in disrepair.
subtitles.zh: 同一地区的另一所学校的老师给我们提供了这些视频，画面显示卫生间、教室、走廊全都年久失修。

subtitles.en: They have not the same chances that all the students in France, because they live in the poor city, in a poor neighborhood.
subtitles.zh: 他们没有和法国其他学生一样的机会，因为他们住在贫穷的城市、贫穷的社区。

subtitles.en: AIDAN STRETCH: For students like Kailyn, he said he'll keep coming back until their demands are met.
subtitles.zh: 像凯琳这样的学生说，他会一直回来抗议，直到他们的要求得到满足。

subtitles.en: We are angry because it is the only thing that-- this is the only thing that we have left, actually, making sure that the government is forced to listen to our voices.
subtitles.zh: 我们很愤怒，因为这实际上是我们唯一剩下的办法了——确保政府被迫倾听我们的声音。

subtitles.en: And tonight, the French government is listening.
subtitles.zh: 而今晚，法国政府正在倾听。

subtitles.en: They announced that they'll bring in 3,000 additional substitute teachers in the next week, a concession to one of the students' demands, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 他们宣布下周将增派3000名代课教师，这是对学生诉求之一作出的让步，托尼。

subtitles.en: Aidan, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 艾丹，谢谢。

subtitles.en: Still ahead on the broadcast tonight, he was booked on a flight but never got on-- the airport detour that got this guy arrested.
subtitles.zh: 今晚节目稍后：他订了航班却从未登机——机场里的一次绕行让这家伙被逮捕了。

subtitles.en: Police say a Delta passenger bound for Seattle decided to skip that flight, break out onto the tarmac, and then steal an airport vehicle.
subtitles.zh: 警方称，一名飞往西雅图的达美航空乘客决定不搭那趟航班，闯进停机坪，然后偷了一辆机场车辆。

subtitles.en: Senior transportation correspondent Kris Van Cleave now on what happened next.
subtitles.zh: 下面由资深交通记者克里斯·范克利夫报道后续情况。

subtitles.en: KRIS VAN CLEAVE: New video of a plane-side John Wayne joyride.
subtitles.zh: 克里斯·范克利夫：新视频拍下了约翰·韦恩机场停机坪旁的一场疯狂兜车事件。

subtitles.en: A 26-year-old man who was waiting for his Delta flight to Seattle apparently opted for a detour, somehow getting onto the ramp and allegedly taking an Alaska Airlines tug for a spin before crashing it into another vehicle at John Wayne Airport in Orange County, California Tuesday night.
subtitles.zh: 一名本来在等达美航空飞往西雅图航班的26岁男子显然临时改了路线，不知怎么进入了机坪，据称还开着一辆阿拉斯加航空的牵引车兜风，最后于周二晚间在加州橙县的约翰·韦恩机场撞上另一辆车。

subtitles.en: PILOT: Hey, ground, SkyWest 3492.
subtitles.zh: 飞行员：嘿，地面，SkyWest 3492。

subtitles.en: Just out of curiosity, you know what's going on with the vehicles behind us with all the law enforcement?
subtitles.zh: 纯属好奇，你知道我们后面那些车和所有执法人员是怎么回事吗？

subtitles.en: AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLER: Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 空管：知道。

subtitles.en: It looks like someone stole a tug.
subtitles.zh: 好像是有人偷了一辆牵引车。

subtitles.en: It was a security breach at the airport.
subtitles.zh: 这是机场的一起安全漏洞事件。

subtitles.en: Someone stole a tug.
subtitles.zh: 有人偷了一辆牵引车。

subtitles.en: KRIS VAN CLEAVE: The airport says the man police identify as 26-year-old Skyler Barr then tried to steal an American Airlines lavatory truck.
subtitles.zh: 克里斯·范克利夫：机场表示，警方确认的这名男子是26岁的斯凯勒·巴尔，他随后还试图偷一辆美国航空的厕所清洁车。

subtitles.en: While he may have had to go, he did not get away.
subtitles.zh: 尽管他也许真的是内急，但他没能跑掉。

subtitles.en: Police arrested him, but the pursuit halted flights for several minutes.
subtitles.zh: 警方逮捕了他，但追捕导致航班中断了几分钟。

subtitles.en: I mean, I don't know.
subtitles.zh: 怎么说呢，我也搞不懂。

subtitles.en: That's crazy, kind of unexpected in Orange County.
subtitles.zh: 太疯狂了，在橙县有点出人意料。

subtitles.en: I worry about our security in our airports, not only here, but everywhere else.
subtitles.zh: 我很担心机场的安全，不仅是这里，其他地方也一样。

subtitles.en: KRIS VAN CLEAVE: An Associated Press review of 31 airports over a 12-year period found airport perimeter breaches occur at a rate of about one every 10 days.
subtitles.zh: 克里斯·范克利夫：美联社对31座机场在12年间的审查发现，机场周界被突破的事件大约每10天就发生一起。

subtitles.en: Barr, from Everett, Washington-- it was no surprise-- booked into the county jail by Orange County Sheriff's deputies on suspicion of trespassing, vehicle theft, and vandalism, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 巴尔来自华盛顿州埃弗里特——这并不让人意外——因涉嫌非法侵入、盗窃车辆和故意破坏公物，他已被橙县警长办公室警员关入县监狱，托尼。

subtitles.en: Kris, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 克里斯，谢谢。

subtitles.en: Up next, a plane crash caught on camera and the passengers who made it out alive.
subtitles.zh: 接下来，一起被摄像头拍下的坠机事故，以及那些死里逃生的乘客。

subtitles.en: A plane landing went very wrong in southern Ecuador today.
subtitles.zh: 今天在厄瓜多尔南部，一架飞机降落时出了大事故。

subtitles.en: Keep your eye on that hillside right side of your screen.
subtitles.zh: 注意看屏幕右侧的那个山坡。

subtitles.en: A Cessna overshot the runway, then bounced up and over the ridgeline there and onto the street below, two people on board.
subtitles.zh: 一架塞斯纳冲出了跑道，然后弹起来越过了那道山脊，落到下面的街道上，机上有两人。

subtitles.en: Officials say both are in stable condition.
subtitles.zh: 有关部门表示，两人情况稳定。

subtitles.en: And trouble aboard a New Jersey Transit bus just before dawn this morning-- the driver suffered a medical emergency moments after leaving the garage and then drifted off the road, hit a parked car in the corner of a house, knocking a hole in the wall there.
subtitles.zh: 今天凌晨黎明前，一辆新泽西运输公司公交出事了——司机在驶出车场后不久突发疾病，车辆偏离道路，撞上了房子转角处的一辆停放汽车，还把墙撞出一个洞。

subtitles.en: The driver has been hospitalized, but fortunately, no one else was hurt.
subtitles.zh: 司机已被送医治疗，但幸运的是没有其他人受伤。

subtitles.en: And do all German shepherds dream of being police dogs?
subtitles.zh: 是不是所有德国牧羊犬都梦想当警犬？

subtitles.en: Because this one in Tampa, Florida recently walked right up to the local police station and wouldn't leave until the cops let him in.
subtitles.zh: 因为佛罗里达州坦帕的这只德牧最近径直走到当地警察局，警察不放它进去它就不走。

subtitles.en: He didn't get a job, but one of the officers did get him over to the vet, who checked his chip and then got him home for a tearful reunion.
subtitles.zh: 它没有得到工作，但一名警官还是带它去了兽医那里，兽医查了芯片后送它回家，与主人泪眼重逢。

subtitles.en: Up next, the good stuff-- a teacher making good on a 25-year-old promise.
subtitles.zh: 接下来是暖心消息——一位老师兑现了一个25年前的承诺。

subtitles.en: We're back with the good stuff, tonight, a once in a generation success story for a high school teacher and one of his students.
subtitles.zh: 我们继续来看暖心消息：今晚是一位高中老师和他一名学生之间难得一遇的成功故事。

subtitles.en: Anthony Simonelli teaches chemistry out there on New York's Long Island.
subtitles.zh: 安东尼·西蒙内利在纽约长岛教化学。

subtitles.en: And every year since 2001, he has promised a $100 prize to any student who gets a perfect score on the state's notoriously brutal chemistry exam.
subtitles.zh: 自2001年以来，他每年都承诺：任何学生只要在纽约州那场出了名地难的化学考试中拿到满分，就奖励100美元。

subtitles.en: But every year, the exam has been too much.
subtitles.zh: 但每年，这场考试都太难了。

subtitles.en: And while some of his students have come close, no one had ever gotten that perfect score, until this year.
subtitles.zh: 虽然有些学生曾经很接近，但从未有人拿到过那个满分——直到今年。

subtitles.en: And to give you an idea of how excited Mr. Simonelli was, he had called and then rushed over to the student's house within minutes to deliver the prize.
subtitles.zh: 西蒙内利先生有多激动呢？他先打了个电话，然后几分钟内就赶到学生家送上了奖金。

subtitles.en: You're the first and only kid-- 3,700 kids have gone through and not gotten a hundred.
subtitles.zh: 你是第一个，也是唯一一个——已经有3700个孩子考过，但没人拿到过100分。

subtitles.en: Jojo, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 乔乔，谢谢你。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Jojo Yawson.
subtitles.zh: 托尼·多库皮尔：乔乔·亚乌森。

subtitles.en: The student hopes to be a civil engineer one day, but as he took the test, he was just a high school sophomore who really, really liked the idea of a $100 prize, as he told our friends at CBS New York.
subtitles.zh: 这名学生希望有一天能成为土木工程师，但考试时他还只是一名高二学生，而且他真的、真的很喜欢那100美元奖金的念头，正如他接受CBS纽约采访时所说。

subtitles.en: REPORTER: Was it in the back of your mind about your teacher's promise for the $100?
subtitles.zh: 记者：老师承诺100美元这件事，你当时是不是隐隐约约有想到？

subtitles.en: Did that matter?
subtitles.zh: 这重要吗？

subtitles.en: No. It did matter, a lot.
subtitles.zh: 不。它很重要，非常重要。

subtitles.en: It wasn't in the back of my mind.
subtitles.zh: 它不是隐隐约约在脑后。

subtitles.en: It was in the front of my mind.
subtitles.zh: 它就在我脑海里最前面。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: So here's the thing.
subtitles.zh: 托尼·多库皮尔：所以事情是这样的。

subtitles.en: Jojo's mom and Mr. Simonelli, who signed the bill, as you can see, want the young man to frame it and never spend it as a reminder of his triumph.
subtitles.zh: 乔乔的妈妈和西蒙内利老师——你可以在钞票上看到他的签名——希望这个年轻人把这张钞票裱起来，永远不要花掉，作为这次胜利的纪念。

subtitles.en: We don't yet know if JoJo has accepted that particular deal, but we do know he's a smart kid.
subtitles.zh: 我们还不知道乔乔是否接受了这个特别的提议，但我们知道他是个聪明的孩子。

subtitles.en: That's another day in America.
subtitles.zh: 这就是美国的一天。

subtitles.zh: 我是托尼·多库皮尔。

subtitles.en: For all of us here at CBS News, thank you very much for watching.
subtitles.zh: 我代表CBS新闻全体同仁，非常感谢您的收看。
